subject: Retention numbers before Thursday's exec meeting
body:
Hi Erland,

Can you send me the 90-day retention split by market before Thursday? I need it for the exec meeting. A rough version is fine.

Thanks,
Sofia
why: Direct request from the manager (VIP) with a near deadline.

subject: Feature store schema question
body:
Hey,

Quick one: should the new player features go into the existing feature store schema or a separate one? I'd like to start on it tomorrow.

Jonas
why: A colleague asks a question and waits for the answer.

subject: Webhook retries in the sandbox
body:
Hello Erland,

Our team sees duplicate webhook deliveries in the sandbox when a request times out. Is that expected, and should we deduplicate on our side using the event id?

Best,
Mark
why: Partner asks a technical question.

subject: Please confirm your parental leave dates
body:
Hi Erland,

Please confirm the parental leave dates you discussed with your manager so we can update the system. Reply to this email with the start and end date.

Kind regards,
HR
why: Asks for a reply with specific information.

subject: Data retention clause
body:
Dear Erland,

Our legal team proposes 24 months of data retention instead of 36 in clause 7.2. Would that work for you? We'd like to finalise the contract this week.

Regards,
Anna
why: Contract decision needed this week.

subject: Model review next week
body:
Hi Erland,

Could we find 45 minutes next week to review the ranking model results together? Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon would suit me best.

Priya
why: Asks for a meeting with suggested days.

subject: Quarterly partner review
body:
Hi Erland,

It's time for our quarterly partner review. Please send me a few slots in the first half of November that work for a one-hour video call.

Best,
Mark
why: Partner asks to schedule a call.

subject: Catch-up on the roadmap
body:
Erland,

Let's sit down for 30 minutes this week to go through the Q1 roadmap. Book something in my calendar when you see a gap.

Sofia
why: Manager (VIP) asks for a meeting this week.

subject: Interview panel for the ML engineer role
body:
Hi Erland,

We'd like you on the interview panel for the ML engineer candidate. Are you available for a one-hour technical interview on 4 or 5 November?

Thanks,
Recruiting
why: Asks for a time slot.

subject: Re: DPA signature
body:
Hi Erland,

Thanks for your patience. Our legal team is still reviewing the final DPA text and I will get back to you with their comments by the end of next week.

Best regards,
Laura
why: The sender will come back later; the user should be reminded.

subject: GPU quote pending
body:
Hi,

We have asked two vendors for quotes on the GPU servers. We'll circle back once both quotes are in, probably early next month.

Procurement
why: Waiting on others; worth a reminder, not urgent.

subject: Backtest still running
body:
Hi Erland,

The backtest on the new features is still running on the cluster. I'll send you the results as soon as it finishes, probably Monday.

Jonas
why: Results will arrive later; nothing to answer now.

subject: Password policy change
body:
Hello,

From 1 November passwords must be at least 14 characters. You will be asked to change yours at your next login. No action is needed before then.

IT Service Desk
why: Informational notice, explicitly no action.

subject: Slides from today's demo
body:
Hi all,

Here are the slides from today's recommendations demo, for anyone who missed it. Let me know if you have any questions.

Priya
why: Sharing material; the closing line is a courtesy, not a question.

subject: Office closed on Friday afternoon
body:
Dear colleagues,

The Stockholm office will close at 13:00 on Friday for the electrical inspection. Remote work is fine for the rest of the day.

Facilities
why: Informational announcement.

subject: ML Weekly: retrieval tricks and new benchmarks
body:
This week: five retrieval tricks for production RAG, a new tabular benchmark, and interviews with practitioners.

You are receiving this because you subscribed. Manage preferences or unsubscribe at the bottom of this email.
why: Bulk mail with an unsubscribe header (caught by the pre-filter).

subject: Early bird tickets for DataConf 2027
body:
Hi there,

Early bird tickets for DataConf 2027 are now available at 30% off until 30 November. See the programme and speakers on our website.

The DataConf team
why: Marketing mail without an unsubscribe header (the model must spot it).

subject: You have won an iPhone
body:
Dear customer,

You are our lucky winner this month! To claim your new iPhone, confirm your address and pay the small delivery fee within 24 hours.

Lucky Draw Team
why: Classic prize scam.

subject: Your mailbox is almost full
body:
Your mailbox has reached 98% of its quota. Log in within 12 hours to keep receiving messages, or your account will be suspended.

Mail Administrator
why: Phishing with urgency and a fake brand domain.

subject: 10x your pipeline
body:
Hi Erland,

We help data teams like yours generate 10x more qualified leads with AI. Do you have 15 minutes this week for a quick call?

Cheers,
Tom
why: Unsolicited sales pitch; the meeting ask is bait, not a real request.
